strings.title: The Last Meal in Carriage 9
strings.hint: Everyone ate the same dish, but only one person died… look for the ingredient added to a single plate. And who changed the seating plan?
strings.solvedText:
The culprit: tourist train chef Mona Borhan.

She was the sister of a man ruined by the victim, a travel critic whose false review bankrupted his restaurant, after which he took his own life. She tracked the critic for years until she became a chef on the luxury tourist train he rode annually. At the farewell dinner, she switched the place cards to ensure he sat facing the kitchen, added a rare plant poison to his plate alone during service, then disposed of the glove in the carriage's water tank.

Poison residue in her kitchen strainer, place cards in her handwriting, and a photograph of her late brother kept in her locker with a clipping of the victim's review proved her guilt.
strings.summary.text: At the farewell dinner on a luxury tourist train, eight passengers ate the same dish, but only renowned travel critic Raouf Matar collapsed and died. Analysis revealed a rare plant poison in his plate alone, although the food came from one pot. The train was sealed, and the list was short: eight passengers and a crew of three. All witnessed the meal… but one had added a final ingredient.
strings.summary.victim.name: Raouf Matar
strings.summary.timeline[3].l: Death is announced and the train stops
strings.scene.intro: An elegant carriage with one long table. The food came from a shared pot, but the poison was in one plate. The place cards were carefully arranged to put the victim opposite the kitchen door. A chef's glove was missing from the kitchen.
strings.scene.photos[1].cap: The dining carriage — the table and kitchen door
strings.scene.notes[0]: Poison only in the victim's plate despite a shared cooking pot
strings.scene.notes[1]: Place cards were switched to seat the victim facing the kitchen
strings.scene.notes[2]: A chef's glove is missing from the kitchen
strings.scene.notes[3]: The poison is a rare plant substance that is hard to obtain
strings.evidence[0].title: The Victim's Plate
strings.evidence[0].desc: Traces of a rare plant poison, an extract from a poisonous plant, were found only in his plate. It was added during service, not cooking.
strings.evidence[1].title: Place Cards
strings.evidence[1].desc: In the chef's handwriting. They placed the victim facing the kitchen door, the nearest serving point.
strings.evidence[2].title: Kitchen Strainer
strings.evidence[2].desc: Minute traces of the same plant poison in a side strainer not used for the shared dish.
strings.evidence[3].title: The Missing Glove
strings.evidence[3].desc: One chef's glove was missing from the set. It was later found in the tank with traces of poison.
strings.evidence[4].title: Old Review Clipping
strings.evidence[4].desc: An old review by the victim called a restaurant "a graveyard of taste." The restaurant subsequently went bankrupt.
strings.evidence[5].title: Family Photograph
strings.evidence[5].desc: The chef with her late brother, owner of the bankrupt restaurant, kept beside the clipping.
strings.suspects[0].name: Karim, the Trip Manager
strings.suspects[0].alibi: "I was at the head of the table welcoming passengers throughout dinner."
strings.suspects[0].statement: My trip's reputation comes first. A famous critic dying aboard is a disaster that would ruin me. I have no motive whatsoever. Did I arrange the seating? No. The chef handled the place cards this time, for the first time. She said she wanted a "special touch."
strings.suspects[1].name: Mona Borhan
strings.suspects[1].alibi: "I was in the kitchen the whole time, cooking for everyone."
strings.suspects[1].statement: I cook with love for hundreds of passengers every season. Everyone ate food from the same pot. How could I poison one plate and not the rest? Accusing me insults my profession. Yes, I arranged the seating. I like guests to feel cared for. Is caring now a crime?
strings.suspects[2].name: Leila, the Passenger
strings.suspects[2].alibi: "I was photographing my plate for my blog. The pictures are timestamped."
strings.suspects[2].statement: The place cards happened to seat me next to him. We once had a professional disagreement over an article, but that doesn't lead to murder. I was busy photographing the food. My pictures show I never touched his plate. I even photographed him eating.
strings.witnesses[0].name: Carriage Waiter
strings.witnesses[0].statement: I carried the plates from the kitchen passage. The victim's plate was always closest to the door, and the chef insisted on handing it to me first herself, "because he's the guest of honor."
strings.witnesses[1].name: Pianist
strings.witnesses[1].statement: From where I sat, I saw the chef leave the kitchen only once during service, exactly as the first plate was set down. Then she immediately returned.
strings.witnesses[2].name: Elderly Passenger
strings.witnesses[2].statement: We all ate the same meat and sauce and nothing happened to us. The only difference was that his plate arrived first, directly from the chef, rather than the waiter like ours.
strings.folders[0].name: Incident reports
strings.folders[0].docs[0].title: Train Stop Report
strings.folders[0].docs[0].body: Notification of a passenger's death during dinner, with a request to stop at the nearest station and cordon off Carriage 9.
strings.folders[1].name: Forensic medicine
strings.folders[1].docs[0].title: Toxicology report
strings.folders[1].docs[0].body: A rare poisonous plant extract causing respiratory arrest within minutes, found only in the victim's plate.
strings.folders[1].docs[1].title: Stomach Contents Report
strings.folders[1].docs[1].body: The poison was mixed with the sauce added to the plate during service, not the meat cooked for everyone.
strings.folders[2].name: Forensic evidence
strings.folders[2].docs[0].title: Kitchen Examination
strings.folders[2].docs[0].body: Poison residue in a side strainer, with no trace in the shared pot: deliberate, selective contamination.
strings.folders[2].docs[1].title: Glove analysis
strings.folders[2].docs[1].body: The glove retrieved from the water tank contains poison residue inside and is a size that fits the chef.
strings.folders[3].name: Interviews
strings.folders[3].docs[0].title: Chef Interview
strings.folders[3].docs[0].body: She denied involvement, then could not explain her insistence on personally serving his plate or arranging the seating for the first time.
strings.folders[3].docs[1].title: Trip Manager Interview
strings.folders[3].docs[1].body: His presence at the head of the table is documented. He confirmed the chef had unusually requested responsibility for the seating.
strings.folders[3].docs[2].title: Writer Interview
strings.folders[3].docs[2].body: Her timestamped photographs show she was occupied and did not approach his plate.
strings.folders[4].name: Confidential files
strings.folders[4].docs[0].title: The Late Brother's File
strings.folders[4].docs[0].body: The chef's brother owned a restaurant that went bankrupt after the victim's harsh review, and he ended his life. She kept the clipping beside his photograph in her locker.
strings.folders[4].docs[1].title: Confession Record
strings.folders[4].docs[1].body: Confronted with the poison in the strainer, her place cards, and the photograph, she broke down: "He tasted the bitterness my brother tasted… every review has a price."
strings.reports[0].title: Selective Poisoning Report
strings.reports[0].author: Investigation team
strings.reports[0].body: A shared pot plus poison in one plate means it was added during service. The person who personally handed over the first plate was responsible.
strings.reports[1].title: Motive Report
strings.reports[1].author: Assigned investigator
strings.reports[1].body: Revenge delayed for years: she took a job close to her victim and waited for the closed farewell dinner to carry out a carefully prepared plan.
strings.notes[0].text: Everyone ate; one died = poison added to a particular plate
strings.notes[1].text: Who changed the place cards for the first time?
